explanation: Even a mild habanero is many times hotter than a fiery jalapeño. The Scoville scale began as a taste test, diluting chilli extract until a panel of tasters felt no heat.

claims.text: Habanero chillies typically measure about 100,000 to 350,000 Scoville heat units.
Jalapeño chillies typically measure about 2,500 to 8,000 Scoville heat units.
The Scoville scale was devised as a taste test in which chilli extract was diluted until a panel of tasters could no longer detect its heat.
